symptom: A synthetic no-op Array.prototype.map makes the pre-v276 canonical object conversion produce {} for distinct valid Forward Vault records. Their digests then collide and same-identity changed evidence can be misclassified as IDEMPOTENT_NOOP. No real research record or score was affected.
lesson: Record admission can be correct while canonical digesting still depends on a mutable array method. A changed record can be silently treated as idempotent when a canonicalization transform drops all object fields.
guardrail: Build sorted canonical objects with indexed own-descriptor loops rather than Array.prototype.map; regression-test unchanged valid digests and same-ID/different-content CONFLICT under a synthetic no-op map, without granting scoring authority.
